title: 8-bit shift register

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, SN54198/SN54199/SN74198/SN74199 (bulletin DL-S 7611841, Dec 1972, rev. Oct 1976)

pins.name: S1
pins.text: mode control; change S0/S1 only while CLOCK is high

rules: CLEAR' low: QA..QH = L at once
S1=H, S0=H: parallel load QA..QH = A..H at the clock edge
S1=L, S0=H: shift right (QA toward QH): QA = SR SER, QB = QAn, ..., QH = QGn
S1=H, S0=L: shift left (QH toward QA): QH = SL SER, QG = QHn, ..., QA = QBn
Change the mode inputs only while CLOCK is high

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm

unknown: Clear-to-output low-to-high is not applicable; no other paths listed.
notes: Bidirectional; four modes: load, shift right, shift left, inhibit.
